gate: Every timing arm meets independent original-world accuracy; exact complete payload parity across timing arms and separately allocation arms after removing only explicit new storage/budget metadata; three alternating complete-call-plus-JSON pairs, median candidate time no worse and each pair <=1.05x baseline; separate 10-sweep Python-traced peak at least 20% lower. Short-arm target misses retained. One fixed experiment, no post-hoc retries.
scope: Same verified four-hand-per-seat/four-flop conditioned preflop/flop betting game and forced future checkdown; original private indexing only. Full original-world and additional streaming budgets enforced before ranking/groups. Standard library only; no shared kernels, later-street betting, Coach or third-party source.
replay_reuse: Independently replay every distinct normalized complete-game payload once. Later arms may reuse metric-only replay evidence only for the same fixture hash and exact normalized full-payload SHA-256; posterior and production metric comparisons still run per arm. No policy objects or strings retained. All six timing payloads must additionally equal the prior verified 500/250 complete-payload hash.
